code_mapping.dominant_index_add: Repeated Lloyd centroid sums in _fit_scalar_codebook plus Pair-VQ compact momentum and projection centroids.
code_mapping.device_select_and_reduce: Dynamic boolean live-code indexing used to write only nonempty centroids.
code_mapping.launch_count: Twenty-four matrices execute their scalar codebook fits and diagnostics serially each optimizer step.

measurement_caveat: Nsight overhead raised measured optimizer time to 1006.83 ms and MFU fell to 14.15%; those values are not a replacement MFU gate. Only operator attribution is used.
decision: First remove dynamic-shape live-centroid selection with a mathematically equivalent static-shape update and verify exact seeded codec outputs. Do not change codec capacity, cadence, state, or optimizer mathematics.
